• Formate il personale del cliente e i dipendenti interni nella tecnologia di fresatura, sia presso l'Accademia di Milling che in loco attraverso la formazione pratica
• create, aggiornate e mantenete materiali di formazione e documentazione del corso, familiarizzando continuamente con nuove tecnologie e attrezzature
• definite e sviluppate ulteriormente i contenuti del corso insieme al team per garantire programmi di formazione di alta qualità e aggiornati
• Supportate i clienti e i partecipanti del corso fornendo assistenza professionale, organizzando visite e rappresentazioni e assicurando un contenuto positivo complessivo
• L'esperienza di formazione
• L'assistenza tecnica e amministrativa viene fornita ai servizi di assistenza e tecnologia, comprese le attività di supporto alle vendite, quali ispezioni dei mulini e assistenza tecnica nelle discussioni Anforderungen:
• Formazione professionale completata come miller o qualifica equivalente, idealmente combinata con una formazione tecnica avanzata nella fresatura (ad es. Scuola Svizzera di fresatura, DMSB, o simili), oltre a diversi anni di esperienza pratica nel settore della macinazione
• Profonda esperienza tecnica in grano, duro, avena e mais, compresa una conoscenza dettagliata di macchinari, aspirazione e pneumatica, completata da una conoscenza di base della tecnologia elettrica e dell'automazione
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale per ispezioni di mulino, formazione dei clienti e supporto in loco, combinata con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in diverse culture e ambienti
• Indipendente, responsabile e motivante personalità con forte forza abilità di lavoro di gruppo, la capacità di rimanere calmi sotto pressione, e una presenza sicura e professionale quando rappresenta l'azienda esternamente
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in arabo, francese e inglese, sia scritto e parlato; lingue aggiuntive come il tedesco o lo spagnolo sono un vantaggio Wirbiet: Attraente diritto di vacanza Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + travelcard a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente biglietto da viaggio di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF.Piano pensionistico finanziato dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensioni Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Abbonamenti per cellulari Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti per cellulari via Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Milling Solutions is the leading specialist in state-of-the-art process technologies for producing high-quality flour and semolina products from wheat, durum, rye, and corn. To strengthen our team in the Milling Academy, we are looking for a committed, entrepreneurial-minded personality as Instructor Process Technology. Aufgaben:
• You train customer personnel and internal employees in milling technology, both at the Milling Academy and on-site through hands-on training
• You create, update, and maintain training materials and course documentation, while continuously familiarizing yourself with new technologies and equipment
• You define and further develop course content together with the team to ensure high-quality and up-to-date training programs
• You support customers and course participants by providing professional guidance, organizing visits and representations, and ensuring a positive overall training experience
• You provide technological and administrative support to the Customer Service and Technology departments, including sales-supporting activities such as mill inspections and technical assistance in discussions Anforderungen:
• Completed vocational training as a miller or an equivalent qualification, ideally combined with advanced technical education in milling (e.g. Swiss School of Milling, DMSB, or similar), as well as several years of practical experience in the milling industry
• Profound technical expertise in wheat, durum, oat, and corn milling, including detailed knowledge of machinery, aspiration, and pneumatics, complemented by a basic understanding of electrical and automation technology
• Willingness to travel internationally for mill inspections, customer training, and on-site support, combined with the ability to work effectively across different cultures and environments
• Independent, responsible, and motivating personality with strong teamwork skills, the ability to stay calm under pressure, and a confident and professional presence when representing the company externally
• Strong communication skills in Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken; additional languages such as German or Spanish are an advantage Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Mobile phone subscriptions We offer special conditions for cell phone subscriptions via Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Bühler Group in Lagos, Nigeria is looking for a skilled professional to join our team as Sales Channel Manager. This role will focus on driving sustainable business growth across Ghana, Liberia, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, and The Gambia by developing and managing Bühler's channel partner and reseller network. This position will also be responsible for increasing market share, while ensuring strong alignment with Bühler's regional and global strategies. Aufgaben:
• Drive market share growth and profitable business expansion in alignment with Bühler's group and regional strategic plans.
• Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities, including emerging markets, customer segments, and distribution channels.
• Strengthen Bühler's market presence in Nigeria by expanding and optimizing partner, reseller, and distribution networks.
• Develop, manage, and grow channel partner relationships, ensuring partners are effectively onboarded, enabled, and aligned with Bühler's standards and business objectives.
• Monitor partner performance and act as the key interface between external partners and internal stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and business delivery.
• Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and opportunity development to proposal submission, negotiation, and order intake.
• Maintain a transparent and accurate sales pipeline, including CRM updates, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and timely follow-up on leads.
• Drive project and plant sales initiatives in collaboration with internal teams such as Sales Support, Technology, and Service to ensure successful project execution.
• Execute business strategies within the assigned territory, collaborating with regional and global teams to achieve defined sales and growth targets. Anforderungen:
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project sales and/or machine sales
• Experience working in a global or matrix organization
• Proven track record in channel partner or reseller management
• Strong market knowledge of Nigeria and/or Africa Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.
